name: The Geneva Ledger
ownerLabel: Demonstration title — no player owner assigned
tagline: A Newspaper of the Treaty Years
description: A broadsheet of record covering the Assembly floor, the Council and the resource ledger, written for readers who want the division lists as well as the drama.
editorialStance: Institutionalist and sceptical of haste; prints full roll calls and corrects in public.

name: Channel L5
ownerLabel: Demonstration title — no player owner assigned
description: A fast-moving broadcast newsroom: bulletins when windows open and close, explainers on the arithmetic, and live coverage of override week.
editorialStance: Fast, plain-spoken and numerate; leans toward explaining procedure rather than taking sides.

name: Afterlight
ownerLabel: Demonstration title — notionally published by Delegationist supporters
description: A quarterly of long essays and interviews on deferral, reserves, digital persons and the obligations of the living to those not yet born.
editorialStance: Openly sympathetic to delegation and slow release; publishes dissent from its own side.
